name: Fool's Gold Nugget
visual: Rough pyrite nugget, brassy crust, one vein of real gold glowing through
blurb: Mostly fool's gold. The vein inside knows better.

name: Hagstone
visual: River-worn grey pebble with a smooth hole bored clean through, faint glow inside
blurb: Water spent a thousand years boring that hole. Yours now.

name: Rat's Eye
visual: Small amber bead with a black slit pupil, mid-dart
blurb: It darts. The orbos dart with it.

name: Storm Knot
visual: Red cord tied in a sailor's wind-knot, faint static arcing between the loops
blurb: A sailor tied the wind in here and never came back.

name: Vial of Rain
visual: Corked glass vial holding a miniature thundercloud and rain
blurb: One small storm, corked. Shake gently.

name: Ghost Candle
visual: Melted candle stub with a pale cold ghost-flame, spectral wisps
blurb: It only burns while nobody's watching.

name: Ghost Thimble
visual: Dented iron thimble slowly filling with glowing pale mist
blurb: Fills with pale mist while you're away.

name: Moonstone
visual: Milky moonstone pebble with a violet crescent glowing inside
blurb: The deep accepts one currency: moonlight.

name: Fallen Feather
visual: A single scorched feather sealed mid-fall in a small charm
blurb: Still falling. Take it with you.

name: Golden Scarab
visual: Gilded scarab beetle, wings ajar, tiny gearwork beneath
blurb: It crawls toward buried gold. Keep up.

name: Whetstone Charm
visual: Deeply dished whetstone on a cord, edges eroded thin
blurb: It wore itself hollow. Now it starts on the walls.

name: Wolf Fang Pendant
visual: A wolf fang wrapped in unravelling silver wire
blurb: The wire's coming loose. So are the orbos.

name: Flawstone
visual: A cut gem with a single glinting fracture through the middle
blurb: Every rock has a flaw. This one shows you where.

name: Thunderflint
visual: A scorched flint striker throwing tiny lightning bolts instead of sparks
blurb: Strike stone, get lightning. Fair trade.

name: Moondial
visual: Pocket sundial casting an impossible violet moon-shadow
blurb: It casts a moon-shadow. The shadow points down.

name: Ferryman's Token
visual: A solid-gold obol stamped with a violet crescent, beaded with water
blurb: Fare for the crossing. It comes back damp.

name: Thunder Hitch
visual: Red cord, two wind-knots, one loop slipping open with a crackle
blurb: One loop keeps slipping. The wind works for free.

name: Alpha's Bit
visual: A snapped iron bit-ring, teeth-marks bitten clean through one side, faint ember glow in the dents
blurb: Chewed through by something that led the pack. It still leads.

name: Geode Heart
visual: Anatomical heart-shaped geode split open to solid gold crystal
blurb: Crack one open. Sometimes it's a vault.

name: Basilisk Scale
visual: A single grey basilisk scale, mirror-polished, its reflections turning to stone
blurb: Whatever it reflects simply stops.

name: Twin-Tailed Obol
visual: Ghost-silver coin spinning mid-fall, both faces showing tails
blurb: Someone filed one face down. Nobody agrees which.

name: Moontide Pearl
visual: A pearl with a miniature violet tide swelling inside
blurb: The tide inside follows a moon nobody's found.

name: Thunderstone
visual: A meteoric stone wreathed in dust and cracks, faint violet halo
blurb: Where it lands, the floor remembers.

name: Serpent's Eye
visual: A golden serpent-slit gem, storm-light flickering in the pupil
blurb: Gold blinks back. Storms flicker behind the slit.

name: The Chipped Tusk
visual: A short broken tusk, tip chipped away, bound in frayed cord and worn smooth by a small grip
blurb: The smallest one kept it. The smallest one kept going.

name: The Loose Tooth
visual: A single oversized fang hung on a fraying cord, hairline crack down its length, tip glowing white-hot
blurb: It waits. Then it doesn't.

name: Lantern of the Long Night
visual: A shuttered iron lantern burning low, its light pooling into loose coins beneath
blurb: It works the night shift. It does not mention what it digs up.

name: Deepwater Flask
visual: A squat glass flask far deeper inside than out, slowly filling with pale mist
blurb: Bottomless, allegedly. Nobody has waited long enough to check.

name: Shackle of the Bound God
visual: A broken god-sized manacle, its chain hanging taut straight down
blurb: Whatever wore it fell. The chain points the way.

name: Tectonic Key
visual: A key cut from a fault line, teeth like eroding cliff faces
blurb: Every fault in the world was cut to fit it.

name: Flawstone
visual: Cut gem, fracture forked into a lightning shape, arcing faintly
blurb: The flaw forked. Now it looks like lightning.

name: Halo of the Fallen Star
visual: A ring of slow meteors orbiting nothing, trailing gold dust
blurb: Meteors on a slow orbit, shedding gold on the way down.

name: Tempest Wreath
visual: A braided cord of storm, three knots, one ghost-pale thread woven through
blurb: One tempest, three knots, one thread you didn't tie.

name: The Lead Metronome
visual: A heavy brass metronome, arm blurred mid-swing, its weight cast as a crowned head
blurb: It only keeps time for whoever is winning.

name: The Drowned Cistern
visual: A stone cistern mouth seen from above, star-flecked water rising impossibly high
blurb: A whole reservoir, folded small. It keeps everything you did not collect.

name: Crown of Antlers
visual: Blackened antler crown, ember-lit tips dipped in gold
blurb: The tips are dipped in gold. The rest is war.

name: Grail of Overflow
visual: A chalice overflowing molten gold that falls through the floor
blurb: It pours more than it holds. The floor can't hold it either.

name: The First Bell
visual: A bell of raw meteoric iron mid-ring, its peal visible as weather
blurb: It rings on its own. Your arm stops aching.

name: Stormheart
visual: A caged cyclone with a glowing eye, bars straining open
blurb: Every landing, the cage flies open. It shuts again.

name: The Last Lantern
visual: A dented tin lantern flaring far brighter than its size, held at the rear of a long dark tunnel
blurb: Handed to whoever walks at the back. It burns hardest there.

name: The Headsman's Whetstone
visual: A black whetstone throwing a fan of gold sparks, one enormous blade edge hovering just above it
blurb: It only sharpens what is already sharpest.

name: The Sleeping Furnace
visual: A vast banked furnace glowing molten through its seams, gold slag pooling at its feet
blurb: It only ever roars when the room is empty.

name: The Last Domino
visual: An obsidian domino frozen mid-tip, its shadow a falling city skyline
blurb: It's been mid-tip forever. Look at its shadow.

name: The Weep of Midas
visual: A single enormous golden tear, the world reflected in it turning gold
blurb: Everything reflected in it appreciates.

name: The Pocket Singularity
visual: An ornate gold locket open on a tiny black hole, violet accretion ring, chain straining toward it
blurb: The deep opens ahead of it, out of respect.
